# Barney Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** twenty-year-old  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Barney is a large, overweight young man. He has a round face that is completely devoid of expression.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Personality

Barney is emotionless and possesses very little capacity for chatter or laughter. He suffers from an agonizing inability to hold a conversation. Despite his quiet nature, he harbors a vast admiration for Nell.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Traits

- emotionless  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- quiet  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- unable to hold a conversation  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>

## History

Barney and his sister Odette drove a double-seated buggy to transport Nell and Isolde to a concert gathering at Pale Sands. Barney insisted that Nell sit next to him on the front seat during the drive. Traveling beside her filled him with immense pride due to his deep admiration for her.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_
